title: Conservative elementary-arithmetic local-link tree bound with fully charged memory

claims.statement: The full protected fixed-G1 pairing inversion algorithm in proof.md succeeds for exactly L/r>0.39, m=39*2^121 and L=m*(2m-1), at total cold classical work at most2^137 dense-Fp12 reference equivalents using fixed C=20000. All processors, initialization, remote transfers, failed queries, sorting, preprocessing, pairings, output and verification are included. All memory accesses use bounded local64-bit addresses and explicit adjacent-node messages. Peak aggregate storage is below2^145 bytes, preprocessing below2^137 equivalents is included, and advice is zero. This is an analytical upper bound, not a practical execution.
